projects.title: Heavy Vehicle Recognition System
projects.role: Final Year Project (FYP) — Machine Learning Research
projects.description: Developed a deep learning system to classify heavy vehicles into small, medium, and large categories based on side-view images. Built using a CNN architecture with ResNet50 as the backbone, trained and evaluated in TensorFlow and Python. The system processes real-world vehicle images captured from road-side angles and outputs accurate size classification to support traffic monitoring and road safety applications.

projects.title: Workshop & Dyno Booking Platform
projects.description: Designed and developed a full-stack car workshop landing page and booking system, including an admin-facing management dashboard. Built with Next.js, Laravel, TypeScript, and MySQL. Features online booking flows, service catalog management, dyno session scheduling, and an admin panel for staff to manage appointments and reduce manual workload.
projects.impact: Reduced booking errors by 80% by replacing manual phone-based bookings with a structured online system. Cut staff workload by 90% through automated appointment tracking and admin dashboard tooling.

philosophy.title: 03. Engineering Philosophy
philosophy.statement: Software engineering is not only about writing code.
philosophy.statementDetail: The real craft is in the decisions made before, during, and after, shaping how a system is built, how a team communicates, and how technology translates to real-world value.

points.label: Understand first, code second
points.detail: Before writing a single line, I seek to fully understand the problem, its constraints, and the people it affects. Good code starts with good questions.

points.label: Build for scalability and maintainability
points.detail: Every architectural decision is made with the future in mind. Code that is easy to change is more valuable than code that is clever.

points.label: Craft meaningful user experiences
points.detail: Software only succeeds when people actually use it. Bridging technical quality with real user needs is where engineering becomes impactful.

points.label: Connect technical decisions with business goals
points.detail: Technology is a means, not an end. I treat engineering choices as business decisions, ensuring every solution moves the needle toward the right outcome.

beyondCoding.title: 04. Beyond The Code
beyondCoding.description: What shapes an engineer is not only what they build, but how they live. These pursuits keep the mindset sharp, grounded, and always evolving.
